parameters.query:
SELECT v.id_equipamento, v.id_veiculo,
       to_char(CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || 'T00:00:00' AS data_inicio,
       to_char(CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || 'T23:59:59' AS data_fim
  FROM bronze.tres_s_veiculos v
 WHERE upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(v.placa,''), '[\s-]', '', 'g'))
       IN (SELECT placa FROM silver.dim_veiculo);

nodes.notes: Saida 0 = DONE (lista esgotada) -> 10 - Deriva Eventos e Expurga. Saida 1 = LOOP (item atual) -> Aquece Sessao 3S. Ordem confirmada no codigo-fonte do n8n (SplitInBatchesV3, outputNames: ['done','loop']).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bronze.tres_s_raw_response
  (metodo, params, http_status, sucesso, tamanho_bytes, response_corpo, erro_msg)
VALUES ('HistoricoPosicao', $2::jsonb,
        CASE WHEN coalesce($1,'') = '' OR $1 LIKE '3S.%'
                  OR $1 LIKE '%ErroProcessamento%' THEN 404 ELSE 200 END,
        (coalesce($1,'') <> '' AND $1 NOT LIKE '3S.%'
         AND $1 NOT LIKE '%ErroProcessamento%'),
        length(coalesce($1,'')),
        coalesce($1,''),
        CASE WHEN coalesce($1,'') = ''
                  THEN 'corpo vazio - veiculo sem posicao na janela'
             WHEN $1 LIKE '3S.%' OR $1 LIKE '%ErroProcessamento%'
                  THEN left($1, 500) END)
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('04 - Request HistoricoPosicao').item.json.data, JSON.stringify({ idVeiculo: $('02 - Loop 1 a 1 (rate limit)').first().json.id_veiculo }) ] }}
